mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 3.8% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 3.8%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 109.0 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during late-cycle economic slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 109.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate exceeding 2.5% within the past month signals aggressive monetary tightening that immediately pressures equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained six-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer spending that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1250.0 thousand units in a single month signals a cooling housing market that reduces consumer confidence and retail activity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1250.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 2.5% and employment growth declines below 0.2% signal tightening monetary policy combined with labor market weakness, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and PAYEMS growth < 0.2%, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.
